historical_reviews.deepseek: Per-slot DMI is necessary but insufficient, and literal equality to OS memory is technically wrong when firmware/kernel reservations are present.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly restores all three views, slot handling, secure transport and owner-approved normalization.
historical_reviews.history: Exact-code/source search found no prior V3.1 record for this identity.
historical_reviews.v3_1: DMI installed capacity, `/proc/meminfo` MemTotal and `free -m` presentation measure related but different quantities and units. The recipe must define the permitted reserved-memory delta instead of demanding byte-for-byte equality.

original_test_intent: Verify the intended full DIMM population and usable OS memory on the exact SUT by comparing every physical slot's identity/capacity/type/rank/speed/ECC attributes with the approved recipe and reconciling installed capacity to the OS-visible total under an explicit reservation policy.
original_method: Authenticate the SUT/host key, pin the board/BIOS/memory recipe, collect complete DMI Type 16/17 memory data, `/proc/meminfo` and `free -m` with exit status and units, enumerate populated and empty slots, sum installed capacity, calculate firmware/kernel reserved delta, and preserve logs without changing memory or BIOS state.
manual_activity: A memory/platform owner approves the slot recipe, field normalization and expected firmware/kernel reserved-memory delta, then resolves any DMI versus OS discrepancy.
required_inputs: Reviewed private Script revision or equivalent
safety_requirements: Do not expose passwords or disable host-key checks
Collect complete outputs and exit status
Do not hotplug DIMMs or change memory interleaving, speed, RAS or BIOS settings
Do not treat unknown or empty slots as populated
Stop on duplicate locators or source contradiction
agent_execution_scope: Collect full DMI and OS memory views
Enumerate physical slots and DIMM identities
engineer_actions: Disposition downclocking, disabled channels or unknown fields

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DMI-only collection omits two required OS views, uses unauthenticated password-bearing SSH and cannot substantiate the claimed OS equality.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Through verified-host SSH, collect complete `dmidecode -t memory`, `cat /proc/meminfo` and `free -m`, preserving units, locators and exit status for structured reconciliation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All three source commands, full-population objective and 20-minute activity remain; insecure transport, log clearing and unsupported literal equality are removed.

modernized_recommendation.status: SLOT-BY-SLOT DIMM BOM TO OS-USABLE-MEMORY RECONCILIATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce a physical slot table plus capacity ledger: sum populated DMI devices, record array maximum/error status, compare MemTotal and `free` totals after unit conversion, and explain the approved reserved delta.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Distinguishes physical installed capacity from OS-usable memory and makes empty-slot and unit handling explicit.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Correct total capacity can hide a missing/replaced DIMM, wrong rank/speed or disabled channel, while normal reserved memory can make correct hardware appear unequal to the OS.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS may expose `Unknown` or configured speed rather than active controller state; the owner must define acceptable alternative evidence for those fields.

project_override_considerations: Define expected slot locators/BOM, whether part/serial data are required, active versus configured speed semantics, ECC/RAS fields, unit conversion and allowed OS-visible memory reservation.
expected_evidence: Complete DMI memory, `/proc/meminfo` and `free -m` outputs with statuses
Per-slot populated/empty table and DIMM attributes
Installed versus OS-visible capacity ledger with reserved delta
Field-by-field discrepancies, no-mutation/log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently request full memory inventory and OS comparison. DeepSeek's incomplete DMI-only method and equality assertion are review defects.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Recipe, access, DMI permission and reservation rules are identifiable inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED only if complete slot identity or authoritative DMI-to-OS reconciliation cannot be established.

review_improvement: Adds a defensible capacity ledger and prevents normal reserved memory or correct totals with wrong per-slot hardware from producing a false result.
independent_technical_reasoning: Firmware inventory reports installed modules, whereas the kernel subtracts reserved address space and presents usable memory. Matching only the total misses slot-level BOM defects; requiring exact installed-to-OS equality mislabels legitimate reservations. Both the per-slot map and an explicit capacity delta are therefore required.
